case.title: Density changes Tech View rows only, not Board View cards or List
case.custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Technician {Technician-A} is active at {Location-A}, with Time Clock on and a Role other than "Office User" or "Time Clock User".
    For example: {Technician-A} is Esther Howard.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has one Approved work order, {Work-order-1}, led by {Technician-A}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Scope and {Work-order-1} is S1-702.
  • In Tech View the density is "Regular", and a second browser tab shows the "Customers" page, opened before you start.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "List" shown, the name of {Customer-A} in "Search", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
case.custom_steps:
1. Look at the height of {Work-order-1}'s row.
  2. Click "Board View" in the display switcher.
  3. Look at the toolbar and at the space around the card of {Work-order-1}.
  4. Click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
  5. Click the density button and choose "Comfortable".
  6. Click the density button and choose "Compact".
  7. Click "Board View" in the display switcher.
  8. Click "List" in the display switcher.
  9. Switch to the "Customers" browser tab and reload the page.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: List shows {Work-order-1}'s row at its usual height.
  • Step 2: Board View shows the card of {Work-order-1} in {Technician-A}'s column.
  • Step 3: Board View's toolbar has no density button.
  • Step 4: Tech View shows, with a density button in its toolbar.
  • Step 5: Tech View's rows become roomier (taller).
  • Step 6: Tech View's rows become tighter (shorter) than at Comfortable and at Regular.
  • Step 7: Board View still has no density button, and the card of {Work-order-1} has the same spacing as at step 3.
  • Step 8: {Work-order-1}'s row in List is the same height as at step 1.
  • Step 9: the Customers table's rows are the same height as before the reload.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 71 (20 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, stories SV-10049 (Story 6, Density in Tech View and Board View) and SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View — board by lead technician); ticket SV-11580

  • S6-E1: “Density applies to Tech View rows on Work Orders; Board View card spacing follows Card size (S3-R11a). List keeps today’s row size, and other application tables are unchanged.”
  • S3-R11: “Board View shows no Density control (SV-11580). Its spacing control is Card size (S3-R11a), which sits beside Column Selection between the toolbar’s two dividers, as in the design.”
  • S6-R3: “Density belongs to Tech View only. Board View’s Card size (S3-R11a) is saved separately.”
  • S6-R2: “Density adjusts spacing and the size of rows, cards, and their elements.”

Last checked against build v26.40.19-1493c63 (staging) on 10/17/2026.

S3-R11, S6-R1, S6-R3 and S6-E1 above are quoted from PRD version 81 (27 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026, after Card size (SV-11581) passed QA on 29 Oct 2026.
